Readable links and checkboxes on every note colour.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Hovering a link no longer turns it a washed-out green on coloured notes.
- Ticked checkboxes show their tick on coloured notes, and the tick is easier to see everywhere.

### 🧰 Self-hosting
- Release notes now live in `.github/release-notes/` and are published to GitHub automatically.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.4.11...v0.4.12](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.4.11...v0.4.12)
